_provenance.why_not_evidence: The pages themselves were never fetched: egress to planning.vic.gov.au, planning-schemes.app.planning.vic.gov.au and the council sites is refused by the network policy (403 at CONNECT). What is recorded here is what a search intermediary reported.
_provenance.reliability_finding: The relay is reliable for identifiers and URL structure, and unreliable for detail. Two independent searches for C232melt gave different gazettal dates (7 May 2026 and 8 May 2026). Two for C272hume described substantively different amendments. Both are marked CONTRADICTED below and none of the relay_claims should be treated as established. Whittlesea leads added 2026-09-20 on the same basis: identifiers and URL structure only. C269wsea's canonical URL appeared in two independent searches; the rest are constructed from the confirmed URL pattern and must be checked against the page before anything is believed about them.
